formulas.firstFrame: full frame 0 includes first renderer shader/program compilation and first draw; initial WebGL construction and asset loading are reported separately
formulas.variants: Each begins with a fresh createWorld + beginWorld at the same positions. Six frames use time 0..5/60. These are diagnostic samples, not twelve-frame warmed benchmark equivalents; programs/textures may be cached from full. Leaf ray/physics CPU work remains active.
